newsitem.title: GREECE: CONSERVATIVE ND DEPUTY KATSIYIANNIS PASSES AWAY-RADIOS.
newsitem.headline: CONSERVATIVE ND DEPUTY KATSIYIANNIS PASSES AWAY-RADIOS.

text.p: Conservative opposition New Democracy party deputy Christos Katsiyiannis died this morning after a long battle with cancer, radios said.
Katsiyiannis, 68, was first elected to parliament with the New Democracy party in 1974 and served as a deputy environment minister in the Mitsotakis government of 1990-1993.
He is survived by his wife Arianna Varela, a son and a daughter.
His funeral will be held on Tuesday, radios said. --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
